title: parity.forecast (0.12.0; 0.15.0 additive)
description: parity-cc-routing -> reports and the cockpit (its PLAN §5.3, §5.4; phase 5): forecast per queue about once a minute: arrivals for the next 8 buckets of 15 minutes, handle time, wrap-up, patience and the VIP share, with the source of every number (the baseline EWMA + profile is always computed; a learned forecaster, phase 5b, falls back to it). Key: tenant_id; headers tenant_id and schema_version (Q12). At-least-once: readers drop a repeated event_id. No personal data (no agent ids, numbers or customer keys). Events are not state: under backpressure RE drops and counts them.

source.description: Where the arrival forecast came from: config_default (nothing observed yet), ewma, ewma_profile (with the weekday/slot profile of routing_bucket_actuals), model (a learned forecaster, phase 5b; the baseline is the fallback)

p10_per_s.description: 0.15.0 (additive): source model only: the 10th percentile of arrivals_per_s

p90_per_s.description: 0.15.0 (additive): source model only: the 90th percentile of arrivals_per_s

aht_source.description: 0.15.0 (additive): where aht_s came from: the baseline (pooled per tenant within its noise), or the learned forecaster when the tenant opted in and it passed the pooled-AHT check

model_version.description: 0.15.0 (additive): source model only: the tenant's model version (0: the shared base model)

fallback.description: 0.15.0 (additive): the learned forecaster is on for the tenant but the baseline stands for this queue, and why (the first reason of the evaluation)
